info.title: Mleha Hermes Integration API
info.description: Hermes support lookups, reports, and privileged live Salla read/write tools. See docs/hermes-salla-handoff.md.

host.description: Production host of the Mleha app (HTTPS only).

get.summary: Find orders by one exact identifier
get.description:
Exactly one of order_number, phone, email, tracking_number. Results are re-verified against the identifier; there is no partial matching.

Required scope: `hermes:support:read`.

post.summary: Find orders by one exact identifier (JSON body)
post.description:
Exactly one of order_number, phone, email, tracking_number. Results are re-verified against the identifier; there is no partial matching.

Required scope: `hermes:support:read`.

requestBody.description: Same fields as the query parameters. Preferred for phone/email so they stay out of URLs and access logs. Do not send a query string with a body.

post.summary: Make an explicitly requested Salla change for an authorized manager. Requires manager PII scope. Resolve internal IDs first; send only requested fields. Never automatically retry a write after any error or timeout: read back the resource to reconcile the outcome.

requestBody.description: JSON body, maximum 4096 characters. query_json and payload_json are JSON-encoded strings.

id.description: Internal Salla ID, not the displayed order reference.

query_json.description: JSON object containing scalar Salla query parameters, e.g. {"keyword":"dress","per_page":20}.

payload_json.description: JSON object containing documented Salla write fields. Only for write operations.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped service API key in the Authorization header. Keys in query strings are rejected. Required scopes are listed per operation (x-required-scope).

Money.description: Decimal amount with exactly two decimals, as a string (never a float).

currency.description: SAR for reports; null for lookups (amounts carry their own currency).

criterion.description: Which search identifier was used (search endpoints).

message.description: Generic, safe message. Never contains internal details.

salla_label.description: Store's own (possibly customised) Arabic status name.

Payment.description: Derived payment state; card, bank and gateway data are never returned.

phone.description: Masked unless the credential has hermes:manager:pii.

carrier_status.description: Carrier's own status, when a live feed exists.

at_local.description: Carrier's raw local time when it could not be parsed.

carrier_status.description: Carrier's own status, when a live feed exists.

reason.description: Predefined reason code (size_issue, changed_mind, defective, wrong_item, other); free-text details are not returned.

coupon_issued.description: Coupon codes themselves are never returned.

customer_note.description: Note typed by the customer on the product.

flags.description: Operational flags already shown to support staff; their internal notes are not returned.

first_order_at.description: Null when the customer has more than 200 orders.

percent_change.description: Percent with two decimals; null when the previous value is zero.

definitions.description: Plain-language definition of every metric whose meaning could be ambiguous.

unconverted_orders.description: Sale orders excluded from money totals because no SAR exchange rate was available.

by_reason.description: Customer-selected return reason (size_issue, changed_mind, defective, wrong_item, other).

top_customers.description: Null items unless the credential has hermes:manager:pii.

order_number.name: order_number
order_number.description: Customer-facing order number. Arabic-Indic digits, '#', spaces and dashes are normalised.

phone.name: phone
phone.description: Full phone number; normalised to E.164 (Saudi 05xxxxxxxx accepted). No partial matching.

email.name: email
email.description: Full email address; case-insensitive exact match.

tracking_number.name: tracking_number
tracking_number.description: Exact carrier or local tracking number.

report_page_size.name: page_size
report_page_size.description: Max 100; applies to every detailed list in the report.

to.name: to
to.description: Last local date (inclusive). Range at most 92 days.

timezone.name: timezone
timezone.description: IANA time zone used for date boundaries.

status.name: status
status.description: Comma-separated normalized order statuses: awaiting_payment, new, processing, ready_to_ship, shipped, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled, return_in_progress, returned, deleted, other.

payment_method.name: payment_method
payment_method.description: Comma-separated Salla payment method slugs, e.g. mada,cod,tabby_installment.

carrier.name: carrier
carrier.description: Comma-separated carriers: smsa, ajex, dhl, aramex, redbox, fedex, ups, local_courier, other.

E400.description: validation_error — details.field and details.reason identify the problem.

E401.description: unauthenticated — missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired key (indistinguishable by design).

E404.description: not_found. Counts toward the per-credential lookup miss budget.

E503.description: temporarily_unavailable (database unreachable, configuration missing, or API disabled).
